mission: Produce a data-preserving, installable, signed Ritsu Control APK with Sticky Snippets; prove app ID/signer/version compatibility and retain the existing phone app's data.
nonnegotiable: Never uninstall or clear data as upgrade workaround
Never modify owner's dirty GodotProjects/home-center checkout
Never log or publish raw signing keys
Never claim a distinct Android package inherits old app's AndroidKeyStore secrets
Cloud-first; no owner debugging known blockers
A preflight-only SUCCESS is NOT an installable APK

gates.required: exact pinned Git SHA and repo-owned tests passed
matching installed Android cert and accessible durable private key
direct verified APK for user's Android Downloads
non-destructive installation, pairing/history/settings preserved, sticky typed/voice pass

branches.detect: git status reports dirty or owner checkout differs
branches.recover: Never fetch/merge/reset in owner working tree; create sparse isolated checkout pinned to SHA
branches.failClosed: fail when isolated checkout is dirty/wrong remote

branches.recover: Disable LFS smudge only for this text/Android-only sparse checkout; verify all required Android assets separately
Use preexisting successful GitHub Actions SDK35 builder, no owner local build

branches.detect: Github fetch/dispatch denied or quota exhausted
branches.recover: Inspect authenticated runner status and credentials; retry bounded once with same intent; do not incur unauthorized paid resources
branches.responsibility: Cloud automated; only credentials/charges require owner approval
branches.failClosed: durable blocked receipt; preserve owner checkout

branches.detect: Gradle tests, Android build or lint fail
branches.recover: Fetch exact CI log, fix smallest scoped source/lint issue in branch, commit and retry bounded cloud job
branches.failClosed: report exact failing task and source SHA

branches.detect: Durable signing key existence, matching fingerprint, installed app certificate unknown
branches.recover: Check authorized protected GitHub signer metadata, legacy build provenance and device package public metadata; match signature and package BEFORE build
branches.responsibility: Cloud investigation first; narrowly scoped device inspection if unavoidable
branches.failClosed: no installable upgrade claim until identity verified

branches.detect: Installed app package ID and public signer digest match safely retained key
branches.recover: Use protected durable GitHub signer; build sign verify package versionCode APK SHA source SHA; deliver direct APK

branches.detect: Protected key found on authorized device but not cloud
branches.recover: Run narrow device signer operation or approved secure transfer without disclosing raw key, only with owner authorization
branches.responsibility: Agent-managed if authorized, else owner consent
branches.failClosed: do not export raw private key into chat/logs

branches.detect: Matching Android package cert has no accessible private key or valid lineage
branches.recover: In-place upgrade impossible; preserve installed app and choose new distinct signed package only with explicit consent, plan export/import or re-pair
branches.responsibility: Owner decides migration/new-install; agent implements alternative
branches.failClosed: no uninstall, no false automatic data transfer

branches.detect: Old and proposed Android applicationId differ
branches.recover: Do not call it an upgrade; side-by-side install with new app data and explicit migration support
branches.responsibility: Cloud can build safe package; owner accepts distinct identity
branches.failClosed: block takeover of old app's private storage

branches.detect: proposed versionCode is not greater than installed
branches.recover: Bump versionCode in source, rerun GitHub build and signer proofs

branches.detect: Android package manager reports signature mismatch, parse error or rejection
branches.recover: No uninstall/reset; compare package metadata, signers, min/target SDK, output digest; rebuild only if compatible
branches.responsibility: Cloud investigate; owner device acceptance required

branches.detect: Fresh package cannot read prior AndroidKeyStore-sealed secrets
branches.recover: Before proposed migration verify supported opt-in export/import; never transfer private keystore material or assume data moved
branches.responsibility: Agent implements, owner consents and approves backup
branches.failClosed: retain old app and mark transfer unsupported

branches.detect: APK installs but tab sticky, import/export, voice, SSE, outbox or pairing fails
branches.recover: Preserve prior working install and logs, repair smallest code surface and repeat signer-consistent release; human final validation
branches.failClosed: no DONE claim from green CI

branches.detect: GitHub dispatch succeeds but response ambiguous or artifact missing
branches.recover: Reconcile job/run ID, source SHA and artifact hash; avoid duplicated dispatch; resume verified stage only
branches.failClosed: record uncertainty and skip speculative retry

terminalOutcomes.COMPLETE: direct signed APK provided, matching installed package cert and higher version, device data preserved by observed update and owner accepts behavior
terminalOutcomes.BLOCKED: operator exhausts allowed recovery paths and names physically missing signer/credential/device approval; prior installation and data kept intact; no preflight presented as fulfillment
terminalOutcomes.ALTERNATIVE_WITH_CONSENT: new package signed with durable new key and intentionally separate storage; explicit user-approved migration/re-pair if supported; never called in-place upgrade
